question: What ritual unification is held to occur when the mantra-holder offers into the mouth of ghee-fire?
premises: The mantra-holder makes an offering in the mouth of ghee-fire.
Mouth unification is associated with this act.
This is stated as the accepted view.
inference: When the mantra-holder offers into the mouth of ghee-fire, mouth unification is held to occur.
uncertainties: The exact ritual meaning of vaktraikīkaraṇaṃ is uncertain.
plain_english: The mantra-holder should offer into the mouth of the ghee-fire; this is held to be the unification of the mouth.
